description: This file contains functions and logic for installing and updating package directories, including handling dependencies, path validation, and npm configuration management.

methods.name: isObjectRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-array object.

methods.name: sanitizeManifestForNpmInstall
methods.description: Removes 'workspace:' dependencies from package.json devDependencies to prepare for npm install.

methods.name: hideProjectNpmConfigForInstall
methods.description: Temporarily moves the project's npm config file to hide it during installation.

methods.name: restoreProjectNpmConfigAfterInstall
methods.description: Restores the hidden npm config file after installation.

methods.name: assertInstallBoundaryPaths
methods.description: Ensures candidate paths are within the install base directory.

methods.name: isRelativePathInsideBase
methods.description: Checks if a relative path is inside the base directory.

methods.name: isInstallBaseChangedError
methods.description: Determines if an error indicates the install base directory has changed.

methods.name: assertInstallBaseStable
methods.description: Verifies that the install base directory has not changed or become invalid.

methods.name: cleanupInstallTempDir
methods.description: Removes temporary directories used during installation.

methods.name: resolveInstallPublishTarget
methods.description: Resolves and validates the target directory for package installation.

methods.name: installPackageDir
methods.description: Main function to install or update a package directory, handling staging, dependencies, and rollback.

methods.name: installPackageDirWithManifestDeps
methods.description: Wrapper around installPackageDir that considers manifest dependencies.
